title: provenance.output
description: Build provenance and supply-chain attestation information.

analyzer.description: Unique identifier for the Provenance analyzer.

repository.description: The image repository that was analyzed.

tag.description: The image tag that was analyzed.

has_provenance.description: True if SLSA provenance or build attestations were found.

has_cosign_signature.description: True if at least one cosign signature (legacy tag or Sigstore bundle referrer) was discovered on the digest the reference resolves to. Discovery alone, not proof: see `verified_signers`.

signatures.description: Signatures discovered on the subject digest.

format.description: cosign v2 `.sig` tag layer, or cosign v3 Sigstore bundle referrer.

location.description: The `sha256-<hex>.sig` tag, or the referrer manifest digest.

verified.description: True when cosign confirmed this signature for the signer its certificate claims.

identity.description: Certificate identity (SAN). Present only when verified.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer of the certificate. Present only when verified.

verified_signers.description: Distinct signers of verified signatures, matched by the `signed-by` criterion.

signatures_complete.description: True when every lookup and verification ran; null when one could not (see `signature_gaps`).

signature_gaps.description: Lookups or verifications that could not run (registry error, cosign missing, trust root unreachable).

source_tracked.description: True if the source repository URL is tracked in metadata.

indicators_count.description: Total number of supply-chain indicators found.

indicators.description: List of specific supply-chain evidence found (e.g., OCI labels, signatures).

key.description: The specific metadata key or ID.
